name: Release
description: Cutting a Substrate release: promote the `dev` branch to `main` plus a version tag. **This is the ONLY flow that touches `main`.** A release candidate moves Ready → Docs Verified → Versioned → Validated → Approved → Released. Each gate carries the guideline for that step (doc verification, version bump, validation, tagging). Full runbook: RELEASING.md.

groups.name: Ready
groups.description: A release is proposed. Record the target `version` (vX.Y.Z; 0.x → minor for features, patch for fixes) and, in `changes`, what has landed on `dev` since the last tag.

groups.name: Docs Verified
groups.description: Every feature launched in this release has current docs — a CHANGELOG entry and any tool/command/API/flag it touched reflected in README/SKILL/AUTHORING/prd. No stale docs. See the gate for the per-feature checklist.

groups.name: Versioned
groups.description: Version bumped in all three sites and the CHANGELOG rotated (via `pnpm release`).

groups.name: Validated
groups.description: Both the full local gate AND GitHub Actions CI are green on the release candidate (the `dev` commit being promoted). CI must pass before the release is tagged.

groups.name: Approved
groups.description: Diego has signed off on cutting the release (dev → main + tag).

groups.name: Released
groups.description: Tagged, `dev` merged to `main`, pushed, the global binary reinstalled, and the installed skill refreshed (`substrate install-skill`).

policies.name: Verify documentation before versioning
policies.description: Docs must be audited against the code and synced before the version is cut.

definition.on_failure_message: Set docs_verified=true only after auditing docs against the CODE **and** against every feature being launched — no doc may be stale. FIRST enumerate what is shipping: `git log <last-tag>..dev --oneline` (and/or the release tasks merged since the last tag). THEN, for EACH launched user-facing change, confirm its docs are updated: (1) it has a CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry — a feature with no entry FAILS this gate (this is the v0.7.0 miss: 6 of 7 features shipped with no changelog line); (2) any tool / command / flag / API / field / error code it added or changed is reflected in README (tool count + command list vs `src/mcp/registry.ts` and the CLI dispatcher), SKILL.md + AUTHORING.md (counts + flows), and prd.md (no claim contradicting shipped behavior — operators, error codes, tool lists, version_mismatch). Use an independent audit agent that cross-checks docs vs code vs the merged-feature list; list each launched feature and the doc(s) that cover it before setting the flag.

policies.name: Bump the version + rotate the CHANGELOG
policies.description: Version must be bumped in all three lockstep sites and the CHANGELOG rotated.

definition.on_failure_message: Set version_bumped=true after `pnpm release <spec>` bumps the THREE version sites in lockstep — package.json, ui/package.json, src/core/version.ts (BINARY_VERSION) — and renames CHANGELOG `## [Unreleased]` → `## [x.y.z] - <date>` with a fresh empty [Unreleased] above. See RELEASING.md.

policies.name: Validate locally + verify CI before approval
policies.description: The full local gate AND GitHub Actions CI must be green on the release candidate before the release is offered to Diego (and before tagging).

definition.on_failure_message: Two conditions, both required. (1) validated=true only after the full local gate — which must MATCH CI: build + BOTH `tsc --noEmit` (root `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` AND `pnpm --dir ui exec tsc --noEmit`, which typecheck the test files the build tsconfig skips) + lint (root + ui) + format:check + all tests (server + ui) + `pnpm test:smoke:concurrency`. (2) ci_green=true only after confirming GitHub Actions CI is GREEN on the `dev` commit being released — `gh run list --branch dev` shows the latest commit's CI run as success. Both gate the tag. (Context: v0.7.0's first tag pointed at a commit whose CI failed on a `tsc --noEmit` error the old local gate missed; this gate exists to prevent that.)

policies.name: Diego approves the release
policies.description: The human-only release gate. An agent cannot promote to main; Diego signs off.

definition.on_failure_message: Diego must approve cutting the release (dev → main + tag) — run `substrate approve <task_id> release_approved`. An agent cannot set this field.

policies.name: Tag, merge to main, reinstall
policies.description: The mechanical release steps must be done before the task is Released.

definition.on_failure_message: Set tagged=true after: `git tag vX.Y.Z` on the release commit + push the tag; merge `dev` → `main` and push; then rebuild + reinstall the global binary AND refresh the installed skill (`substrate install-skill`, then `substrate diagnose` reads "Skill: in sync") — see RELEASING.md 'After a release'.

policies.name: Documentation verification checklist
policies.description: Fires while a release candidate is in Ready — the doc audit to run before versioning.

definition.message: Before versioning, prove no doc is stale for the features being launched. START from the shipped set: `git log <last-tag>..dev --oneline` (and the release tasks merged since the last tag) — walk EACH one. For every launched feature confirm: (a) it has a CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry (a feature with no entry is the default failure — v0.7.0 shipped 6 of 7 with none); (b) whatever it added/changed is reflected in the docs — README (tool count vs src/mcp/registry.ts, command list vs the CLI dispatcher/HELP), SKILL.md + AUTHORING.md (tool counts + flows), prd.md (no claim contradicting shipped behavior — operators.ts, error codes, read/write tool lists, version_mismatch/current_version). An independent audit agent that cross-checks docs vs code vs the merged-feature list is ideal. Fix every gap, then set docs_verified=true.

policies.name: Version + tag steps
policies.description: Fires while cutting the version — the lockstep sites and tagging steps.

definition.message: Release mechanics (RELEASING.md): version lives in THREE lockstep sites — package.json, ui/package.json, src/core/version.ts. Cut with `pnpm release <spec> --tag` from a clean tree (or `pnpm release <spec>` then run the printed git steps). Tags are `vX.Y.Z` (not the phase-NN dev tags). Then merge `dev` → `main`, push both, and reinstall the global binary.

policies.name: Match CI in the local gate, then verify CI
policies.description: Fires while a release candidate is in Versioned — how to validate so local matches CI, and to confirm CI itself is green before approval/tagging.

definition.message: Validate so LOCAL matches CI, then verify CI. Local (then set validated=true): build + `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` + `pnpm --dir ui exec tsc --noEmit` (these typecheck the TEST files that `pnpm build` skips — the class of error that broke v0.7.0's first tag) + lint (root + ui) + format:check + `pnpm test` + `pnpm --dir ui test` + `pnpm test:smoke:concurrency`. CI (then set ci_green=true): confirm GitHub Actions is GREEN on the `dev` commit being released — `gh run list --branch dev --workflow CI` shows the latest as success. Do NOT tag until BOTH validated and ci_green are set.
